lines.cap: Heaven has a customer care number. Please hold.
lines.say: Heaven has a customer care number. Please hold.

lines.cap: Thank you for calling heaven. Press one for Hindi. Press two for clouds.
lines.say: Thank you for calling heaven. Press one for Hindi. Press two for clouds.

lines.cap: I just want to know why I can't get in!
lines.say: I just want to know why I can't get in!

lines.cap: Your call is important to us. Please hold for eternity.
lines.say: Your call is important to us. Please hold for eternity.

lines.cap: Hold music. For four hundred years.
lines.say: Hold music. For four hundred years.

lines.cap: I've heard this flute song one billion times.
lines.say: I've heard this flute song one billion times.

lines.cap: Finally. A human answers. It's Death.
lines.say: Finally. A human answers. It's Death.

lines.cap: Hello. I'm covering the night shift. Have you tried dying again?
lines.say: Hello. I'm covering the night shift. Have you tried dying again?
